description: A website check written for a non-technical owner and ready to send under your brand: verdict, headline, summary, what works, fixes ranked by business risk with why each matters, plus finished HTML and Markdown. Use when an agency, freelancer or platform needs a report to hand to a client about the client's website, or when a non-technical owner asks 'is my site OK?'. Runs the launch scan (keys leaked in JavaScript, public .env/.git, HTTPS and security headers, Google and link-preview basics, SPF/DMARC/DKIM, domain expiry, AI readiness), then writes plain-English findings in any language. Pass url, optional client_name, language and brand {name, website, logo, color}; a partner account's saved brand is used when brand is left out, brand=false removes all branding. Returns verdict (good, needs_work, at_risk), headline, summary, strengths[], fixes[] {id, area, title, why, priority urgent/soon/later, effort, fixPrompt}, nextStep, score, grade, counts, writtenBy, scan (the raw launch scan; include_scan=false drops it), html (a complete self-contained page to email or host) and markdown. Every fact comes from the scan; the writing step never adds findings. Not charged when the site can't be reached. For the raw checks only, use launch_scan. Price: $0.10 per call from Exepal credit; not charged if the call fails.

brand.description: Optional: your brand on the report. {name, website?, logo? (https image URL), color? (#hex)} or just a name. Left out: the brand saved on your partner account (exepal.com/account#partner). false: no branding at all.

client_name.description: Optional: the client's business name, shown on the report

include_scan.description: Default true. false leaves out the raw scan to keep the response small.

language.description: Optional: language of the report, e.g. English (default), Spanish, Hindi, Nepali

url.description: The client's live site, e.g. https://client-site.com (a bare domain works too)

name: client_report

brand.description: Brand on the report; null when unbranded

client.description: Client name shown on the report

fixPrompt.description: Copy-paste instructions for a developer or AI builder, from the scan

why.description: Why it matters, in business terms

html.description: Complete self-contained HTML page, ready to email, print or host

scan.description: The raw launch scan (left out when include_scan=false)

id.description: secrets, security, seo, email or ai

fix.description: Copy-paste fix prompt for an AI builder, on problems

writtenBy.description: The model that wrote the plain-English layer, or rules

title: Client-ready website report (white-label)
